assignments.node_id: שאלו העשרה קפיטל תהלים, הם תקון גדול מאד מאד למקרה חס ושלום, ומי שזוכה לאמרם באותו היום
assignments.reason: This compound node describes the recitation of the ten chapters of Psalms as a great tikkun. Its essential nature is the practical application of the ten-structure of da'at (= 5 chesed + 5 gevurah), which is the core identity of Package 1. The ten chapters are the concrete vehicle through which the עשרה לשונות and עשרה מיני זמרה (both in Package 1) operate. The node is not merely causally connected to Package 1 — it IS the ten-fold chesed-gevurah remedy expressed as a mitzvah-act.

assignments.node_id: אין צריך לפחד עוד כלל מפגם הנורא של המקרה, חס ושלום, כי בודאי נתתקן על ידי זה
assignments.reason: This node is the assurance that the tikkun is complete — the blemish is certainly rectified. Its essential nature is the accomplished restoration of the fallen טפה (seed) to holiness, which is the culmination of the chesed-gevurah mechanism. The Torah teaches that the two names אל אלקים (= chesed and gevurah = gematria of תהלים) are what extract the seed from the klipa. This node describes the state where that extraction is fully achieved — the seed is restored to its source in דעת. It belongs to the same essential domain of holy chesed-gevurah restoration that defines Package 1.

This is the ten chapters of Psalms as a discrete concept. Its essential nature is identical to the עשרה לשונות and עשרה מיני זמרה already in Package 1: it is the concrete ten-fold structure that embodies דעת = חמשה חסדים וחמש גבורות. The Rebbe explicitly states 'עַל כֵּן צָרִיךְ לוֹמַר עֲשָׂרָה קַפִּיטְל' — therefore one must say ten chapters — BECAUSE דעת = 5+5. The ten chapters are the practical form of the ten-structure of da'at, placing this node squarely in the chesed-gevurah-da'at domain.

assignments.node_id: תקון גדול מאד מאד למקרה חס ושלום
assignments.reason: This node names the tikkun itself — the great rectification for the nocturnal emission. Its essential nature is the restorative power of chesed and gevurah working through Psalms. The Torah's entire argument is that the tikkun works because תהלים = אל אלקים (chesed and gevurah), and these two divine forces extract the טפה from the klipa and restore it to דעת. The tikkun is not an external consequence of the chesed-gevurah mechanism — it IS the chesed-gevurah mechanism in its accomplished form. The concept of tikkun in this Torah is inseparable from the essential identity of the package.
